title: A ORIGEM DE POPPY, A MARIONETE DO OLHAR 👁️🧵 | SOUL WAVE
author: Just_Amoeba7123
selftext:
Hi everyone! I'm developing an indie game called **SoulWave**, and I wanted to share a teaser featuring one of the characters, Poppy.

To create this promotional material and the character concept, I heavily relied on generative AI. Here is my workflow:

* **Concept Art:** I used Google Ai Studio + ChatGPT to explore the initial "creepy gothic marionette" aesthetic.
* **Video Generation:** To give her life in this cinematic teaser, I animated the static images using Google Flow.
* **Game Integration:** At the end of the video (0:14), you can see how this high-fidelity AI concept translates into the actual 2D gameplay style of SoulWave.

**Discussion:** For those of you making 2D games, how are you using AI 3D/Cinematic generations to promote your games without misleading the players about the actual gameplay graphics? I tried to show both here.

I'd love to hear your feedback on the character design and the workflow!
